src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2022 Act 89 (H.722): the final senatorial districts (16 in the Census file, including Chittenden Central, Chittenden North, Chittenden Southeast, Essex and Orleans)

Vermont General Assembly, 2022 Act 89 (H.722), same title; Date Governor signed bill: April 6, 2022; applies to the 2022 election cycle and thereafter (repeals 2022 Act 80, the 'initial districts' act)

Census cb_2022 sldu file: LSY 2022, 16 districts named as in Act 89 (Chittenden Central, Chittenden North, Chittenden Southeast, Essex, Orleans...); 9 districts exist in both the 2020 and 2022 files and all 9 differ by more than 0.5 percent (up to 42 percent). Equals the 2024 file (max 0.1 percent).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2022 Act 89 (H.722): the final House districts (109 districts in the Census file)

Vermont General Assembly, 2022 Act 89 (H.722), same title; Date Governor signed bill: April 6, 2022; applies to the 2022 election cycle and thereafter (repeals 2022 Act 80, the 'initial districts' act)
Census cb_2022 sldl file: LSY 2022, 109 districts; equals the 2024 file (max 0.4 percent). Only the final-district act (Act 89) was used for the 2022 election; Act 80 was repealed by it.
